translated: When I hear Hon-chan's soft voice, I'm like, "Wow."
I feel healed in that way.
I used to worry that if I talked to you while you were focused, like telling you there was good food in the hall, I'd be bothering you.
Not at all, not at all.
Hon-chan is a real mood maker.
Wait, do you have moments like that too, Hon-chan?
Just like Yui-chan said earlier, when I get home and I'm all alone...
Ah, so you do have them.
I start thinking, "Why couldn't I do it like that then?" or "I could've done this better," and I end up feeling really frustrated.
Even if it's something I can't control, I still feel frustrated or a bit down, but...
In those moments, I let my cat comfort me. It's so healing.
